content.location: canonical Work Unit execution-context in the primary repository and Codex app-server Goal state
items: Work Unit JSON stores revision, attempt, invocationId, invocationChain, progress, recovery and terminal result.
Codex app-server owns Goal and turn history.
Git owns changed code and commits only for worktree mode.
Specification manager owns specification-direct mutations.
No Git HEAD, content hash, immutable snapshot or artifact checkpoint is an execution identity.

transitions: planned -> running after background Goal+Exec launch
running -> running after interrupted or stale blocked continuation
running -> review after Execution, AI Review and Report evidence
review -> done after Human complete and automatic integration when applicable
forbidden: immutable snapshot or Git HEAD identity

items: Canonical CRUD always targets the primary repository manager.
Every active continuation stays in the same Goal thread and appends a unique invocation ID when required.
Execution mode remains fixed for the Work Unit attempt.
Specification-direct never depends on a linked worktree.
Worktree mode never carries .agent-factory into the linked worktree.
Terminal result references registered verification evidence, not a Git snapshot hash.
Legacy invocationChain history remains readable.
execution-migrate converts v1 checkpoint progress into v2 records and removes Git subject fields.
Omitted legacy executionMode defaults to worktree.
New specification-direct contexts may omit branch and worktreePath.
No migration to SQLite or external databases is required.

invariants: ACK 이후 blocked 또는 failed terminal state를 사용하지 않는다.
completed node는 동일 revision resume에서 재실행하지 않는다.
executed-but-unmerged node는 node 실행을 반복하지 않고 merge부터 재개한다.
병렬 code node는 같은 eligible package branch snapshot에서 시작한다.
merge와 ready selection은 topological order와 stable node id로 결정한다.
rework는 영향 node와 descendants만 새 revision으로 연다.

items: The supervisor writes a bounded non-canonical runtime sidecar containing launcher pid, thread id, state and latest heartbeat timestamp.
Canonical Work Unit lifecycle and execution state remain owned exclusively by work_unit.py.
Reconciliation does not mutate canonical JSON; it reports stale-canonical and an evidence-derived effective state.
Runtime sidecars are excluded from Git and do not cross the compact execution stdout boundary.
